remarks:
Welcome to Woodland Hills — Clarence’s newest and most prestigious community. This exceptional newly designed model home is now available for sale, offering an unparalleled combination of luxury, comfort, and thoughtful design. This stunning residence is completely move-in ready and showcases an impressive array of high-end finishes and features.

A spacious front porch welcomes you into a dramatic two-story foyer, setting the tone for the elegant yet inviting interiors. At the heart of the home, the gourmet kitchen features sleek soap stone countertops, copper sink and an expansive center island, and all appliances included. The kitchen flows seamlessly into the sun-filled family room creating a warm and connected living environment.

Two sets of sliding doors with transom windows extend the living space outdoors to an impressive 23' x 13' covered rear porch — an ideal setting for relaxing and entertaining. 

Thoughtfully curated details continue throughout the home, including custom window treatments, extensive landscaping with a sprinkler system, a stylish wine bar, corner bookcases, and a private home office with built-ins. Additional highlights include a 9' basement, two-zone heating, and a convenient mudroom connecting directly to the three-car garage.

The luxurious first-floor primary suite offers a private, spa-inspired retreat. Two walk-in closets provide exceptional storage, while the beautifully appointed primary bath features heated floors, dual sinks, a ceramic tile shower, soaking tub, private commode room, and spacious linen closet. Sliding doors from the suite provide direct access to the covered rear porch, creating an effortless connection between indoor and outdoor living. Upstairs, three additional bedrooms, two full baths, and a versatile loft provide generous space for family, guests, or additional living needs.
From its exceptional outdoor living spaces to its sophisticated interior finishes, this home is a true standout in Woodland Hills and an extraordinary opportunity to own a luxury home in one of Clarence’s premier new communities.

Open House: Monday–Wednesday and Saturday–Sunday, 1:00–5:00 PM.
Taxes: TBD.
